symbols.name: ClarifyChoices
symbols.sig: export function ClarifyChoices({ ask, onAsk }: { ask: DepartmentAsk; onAsk: (query: string) => void })

behaviours: one checkbox per department, in order
nothing is ticked at the start
Continue is there and disabled until something is ticked
None of these is a separate button, not a checkbox
a question about people has no documents button
nothing is said about the search before something is ticked
it is a fieldset with a legend for a screen reader
every button is a plain button (none submits a form)
one option only: one checkbox and NO Select all (it would mean nothing)
a bare word offers the documents button
a label with an apostrophe or quotes is escaped, not broken
